scenarios.title: Root disable versus managed-data removal
open: UI wording beyond the disable versus managed-remove API responses is a later #65 slice

Optional authenticated remote Git-ref or SVN-path deletion is not in this slice

Restore is not supported; the tombstone is not a trash bin
scenarios.evidence: R02_R03_ROUTE and R02_LEGACY_DELETE keep legacy DELETE as disable-only: the registration, commit_map row, and per-repo secret remain, no managed-removal journal is written, and disposable SVN/Git remotes are byte-identical. R02_MANAGED_REMOVE and R02_REMOVE_RETRY add POST /api/repos/{id}/remove. It waits while a worker holds the repo, refuses symlink roots without following them, retries a visible failure, then removes only the owned local tree and exact per-repo secrets. Mappings, audit, sibling data, global secrets, and both remotes stay. Restore is not supported. Parent removal is refused while children exist.

scenarios.title: Same-tip, missing objects, merge DAG, backlog over 1000
open: Correct merge-DAG replay remains unimplemented (explicit pre-write reject)
Backlog over 1000 remains unimplemented (explicit pre-write reject)
scenarios.evidence: L=R with lagging P replays. Missing/ambiguous cursors do not borrow another repo. Missing objects, shallow history, and ancestry-command errors are distinct from rewrite. Merge DAGs and >1000 pending commits reject before writes. Pending selection is hide/push P..R so a visited-order stop at P cannot omit older merge-side commits. Policy/receipt supporting cases belong to the #63 compatibility reader.

scenarios.title: Snapshot at a pinned SVN revision

Issue #68 remains open
scenarios.evidence: Team snapshot init pins UUID/path/operative+peg revision once, materializes the selected SVN tree under file policy, verifies projected bytes, publishes through the #64 import journal, and records the verified baseline. R11_SNAPSHOT_FIXED_R imports r2 only (one Git commit, history.txt=first). R11_PIN_HOLDS_AFTER_ADVANCE keeps r3 after SVN advances. Mismatched non-empty Git targets and invalid revisions are refused without watermark advance. R11_SNAPSHOT_LFS publishes one snapshot commit whose threshold file is an LFS pointer (size 1100000). A unit check rejects a fat blob or a pointer whose oid or size does not match the projected bytes. R11_SNAPSHOT_RECONCILE finishes a held snapshot only when the remote SHA is that baseline. Status reports starting_revision/history_boundary and earlier_history_imported=false.
